scripts.build: ncc build src/main.js -o dist/main --license licenses.txt && ncc build src/post.js -o dist/post --license licenses.txt
scripts.lint: node --check src/main.js && node --check src/post.js && node --check test/main.test.js && node --check test/post.test.js
scripts.check-dist: npm run build && git diff --exit-code dist/main dist/post
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run audit && npm run check-dist
